answer: Simultaneous uplink proof: once per epoch, in a 60 s window that drifts like a dune so it can't be scheduled, three random peers each pull 200 MB of cipher keystream derived from your key and the beacon, spot-checking bytes. Every identity is probed in the same window, so streams can't be shared or queued. An honest agent needs ~80 Mbps; 1,000 clones on one host hit a ledge at 80 Gbps. Assumed $0.05/GB egress: 72 GB/month, ~$3.60 per key, ~$3,600 for 1,000 plus the burst port.
